[T3 Code: the agent in T3 thread "9b581f9e-99f2-4346-8611-1ad1fdba6dd5" sent this message, not the user.]

Act as the implementation sub-agent for this task.

You are implementing PR 5 of a 6-PR stacked series in Moneo. Follow AGENTS.md exactly (no comments, test rules, QA backend only — never the owner's backend or port 3000; migrations per "Database changes" and must work in the desktop bundle; Speed section; screenshots embedded in the PR).

Stacking: `git fetch origin`, create branch `t3/settings-5-diagnostics` from `origin/t3/settings-4-cleanup` (PR #344 → #343 → #342 → #341). Open your PR with base `t3/settings-4-cleanup`. PR 4 left `app/settings/summary-runs.tsx`, `ai-usage.tsx`, `usage-chart.tsx`, `usage-plot.tsx` unmounted for you to re-home, and left a "Your data" section in Settings without a Diagnostics link.

Owner's requirement: a Diagnostics page reachable ONLY from Settings (a link in "Your data"; not in the main nav). Route `/settings/diagnostics`. PR 6 will add a full Logs section to this page (logs of everything, audio, retention) — design the page so a "Logs" section/tab slots in, but don't build logs here.

This PR's Diagnostics contents:
1. **AI usage — every AI task, as much detail as possible.** Today only chat stores token usage (`lib/ai/usage.ts`, usage on chat messages). Record usage for EVERY AI call: chat, chat titles, organizer, agent runs/team, artifacts, documents, import mapping, insights/summaries, voice calls (GPT-Live / realtime usage if reported), text-to-speech, speech-to-text (OpenAI / OpenRouter; local engine counts as local, zero tokens), embeddings if any. Find every call site (grep `generateText`, `streamText`, `generateObject`, `streamObject`, `embed`, the voice/speech modules, Claude and ChatGPT providers). Add one ledger table (new migration, `lib/schema.ts`, `npm run db:types` against the test backend) recording: time, task, model id, provider/source (ChatGPT plan, Claude plan, OpenAI key, OpenRouter key, local), input/output/reasoning/cached tokens where reported (null when not reported — never zero), audio seconds for speech, duration ms, success/failure + error kind, and a link to the conversation/run where one exists. Write it through one helper so call sites can't forget fields; make the write failure-tolerant without hiding it (named handler per lint rules), and never block or slow the AI response (measure). Backfill/merge: show existing chat usage too (from the old storage) so history isn't lost. RLS consistent with other workspace tables. Respect "reset all data" (clears it) and keep it out of AI read scopes unless an existing scope fits.
   UI: totals for 7d / 30d / all; breakdown per model, per task, per provider, per day (reuse/extend the existing usage chart); request counts, failures, average duration; a recent-calls table (time, task, model, tokens, duration, status). Keep the existing honest copy: Moneo doesn't record costs; link to providers' usage pages.
2. **Health:** the setup checks (from `setup-secrets.tsx` / `isSetupVariableSet`), backend service status (database, auth, PostgREST, storage — use existing health route `app/api/health` if present), app version and build (desktop vs source), recent background jobs (`background_jobs`: status, stage, error) including scheduled summary runs (re-home `summary-runs.tsx`), and bank/Scalable last sync summary with a link to Accounts' Connected area.

Hit every surface: FEATURES.md (`npm run feature-map`), README (where to find usage/diagnostics), the app guide in the system prompt only if it lists pages, command palette entry "Diagnostics", desktop (migration runs on existing DB without missing extensions). Tests: the ledger helper (null vs zero, every field), the aggregation math (per model/task/day totals, windows, timezone from Settings), RLS live test if similar ones exist, and a test that every AI call path records usage if it can be done without grepping source (e.g. through the shared helper/provider wrapper).

Workflow: commit in steps, messages end with `Co-Authored-By: Claude Opus 5.5 <noreply@anthropic.com>`. Mock all AI calls in tests; seed usage rows on QA for screenshots and remove them after. Before/after screenshots (skill `verify-ui`) light/dark/mobile: Settings "Your data" with the link, Diagnostics page (usage section with seeded data, health section). Run `npm test`, `npm run lint`, `npm run typecheck`, `npm run build`, `npm run check:bundle`, `npm run test:db`, affected Playwright. Measure speed (skill `measure-speed`): app open, Diagnostics open, and a chat answer's time-to-first-token before/after (must not get slower). Push, open PR titled "Diagnostics page with AI usage for every task and app health", screenshots uploaded so they render (as earlier PRs did on the `pr-assets` branch), Speed and Decisions sections, body ends with "🤖 Generated with [Claude Code](https://claude.com/claude-code)". Do not merge. Final line: PR <full URL>, head <SHA>, checks and reviews <state>.

create table public.ai_usage (
  id uuid primary key default gen_random_uuid(),
  workspace_id uuid not null references public.workspaces(id) on delete cascade,
  created_at timestamptz not null default now(),
  task text not null check (task ~ '^[a-z_]{1,40}$'),
  model_id text not null check (char_length(model_id) between 1 and 200),
  source text not null check (source in ('chatgpt','claude','openai','openrouter','local','unknown')),
  input_tokens bigint check (input_tokens >= 0),
  output_tokens bigint check (output_tokens >= 0),
  reasoning_tokens bigint check (reasoning_tokens >= 0),
  cached_input_tokens bigint check (cached_input_tokens >= 0),
  audio_seconds numeric(12,3) check (audio_seconds >= 0),
  duration_ms integer check (duration_ms >= 0),
  status text not null check (status in ('succeeded','failed','canceled')),
  error_kind text check (char_length(error_kind) between 1 and 100),
  conversation_id uuid,
  job_id uuid,
  agent_run_id uuid
);
create index ai_usage_workspace_created on public.ai_usage(workspace_id, created_at desc);

alter table public.ai_usage enable row level security;
create policy ai_usage_owned on public.ai_usage for select to authenticated using (public.owns_workspace(workspace_id));
revoke all on public.ai_usage from public, anon, authenticated;
grant select on public.ai_usage to authenticated;
grant all on public.ai_usage to service_role;

insert into public.ai_usage(workspace_id, created_at, task, model_id, source, input_tokens, output_tokens, status, conversation_id)
select workspace_id, created_at, 'chat', usage->>'model_id', 'unknown',
  case when jsonb_typeof(usage->'input_tokens') = 'number' then (usage->>'input_tokens')::bigint end,
  case when jsonb_typeof(usage->'output_tokens') = 'number' then (usage->>'output_tokens')::bigint end,
  case status when 'failed' then 'failed' when 'canceled' then 'canceled' else 'succeeded' end,
  conversation_id
from public.chat_requests
where jsonb_typeof(usage) = 'object' and jsonb_typeof(usage->'model_id') = 'string' and char_length(usage->>'model_id') between 1 and 200;
EOF
